# The snowball, r 1.0 (the game scales it 0.4 to 1.15), origin at its centre (the roll's pivot).
# An 80-face ball, a third of its faces packed snow (peach), two twigs and three pebbles stuck in it.
# Generated by make_env.py.
new
material new Snow --base-color 1.000 0.965 0.827 --no-slot
material new Packed --base-color 0.976 0.659 0.459 --no-slot
material new Twig --base-color 0.486 0.247 0.345 --no-slot
add mesh ico-sphere --name Ball --subdivisions 2 --radius 1.0
material assign Snow
active Ball
mode edit
select mode face
select random --ratio 0.3 --seed 4
material assign Packed
mode object
add mesh cube --name TwigA --size 1 --location 0.62 -0.55 0.55 --rotation 30 40 0
scale 0.12 0.12 0.75
add mesh cube --name TwigB --size 1 --location -0.7 0.3 -0.6 --rotation -40 10 60
scale 0.12 0.12 0.7
add mesh ico-sphere --name PebbleA --subdivisions 1 --radius 0.16 --location -0.3 -0.93 -0.1
add mesh ico-sphere --name PebbleB --subdivisions 1 --radius 0.16 --location 0.2 0.5 0.85
add mesh ico-sphere --name PebbleC --subdivisions 1 --radius 0.16 --location 0.9 0.35 -0.25
select TwigA TwigB PebbleA PebbleB PebbleC
apply --scale
material assign Twig
select all
shade flat
export ball.glb
